metadata.auditor: Skeptical Computational Protein Engineering Self-Auditing Team
metadata.purpose: Phase B pre-registered criteria for PETase variant validation, structural gates, MD simulation, and manuscript outcome decision
hard_rules: Never invent, estimate from memory, or round-fabricate any number.
Every reported value must trace to a logged tool run on disk.
Predicted values must be explicitly labeled as 'predicted'.
Predicted and literature-measured values never share a column without explicit labels.
Never state or imply a Tm for any designed variant without experimental calibration.
Pre-registered thresholds are LOCKED. Never edit after seeing results.

validation_protocol.held_out_set_requirement: >=30 literature PETase variants with experimental Tm/DeltaTm, each with DOI and source table/figure, excluding mutations in FAST/Thermo/Dura/Hot backgrounds. If fewer exist, report actual n and weaken claims accordingly without padding.
validation_protocol.sign_convention: ThermoMPNN: negative ddG = stabilizing; Experimental: positive DeltaTm = stabilizing. Expected rho is NEGATIVE.

pass_criterion.interpretation: rho <= -0.50 AND 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0.0

predictors.secondary: ESM-2 masked language model (Lin et al. 2023, Science 10.1126/science.ade2574)

decision_rule_for_outcome.rule: IF (validation passes pre-registered criterion) AND (>=1 candidate passes all structural, predictor consensus, and MD gates) THEN OUTCOME = 'DESIGN' (methods + computational shortlist paper) ELSE OUTCOME = 'AUDIT-ONLY' (negative-result / forensic audit paper of automated AI-agent protein design).
decision_rule_for_outcome.mandatory_section_both_outcomes: Audit story of Round 1 failure (0.0000 Å RMSD bug, additive scalar heuristic ddG bug, unclosed proline rings, positive-phi prolines, clash checker skipping i+/-1).
